note: Generated by scripts/collect-architecture.mjs from the repositories. Do not hand-edit.

layout.name: Ports-and-adapters layout
layout.target: >= 95% of source files inside cmd/ or internal/ (Go) or src/ (TypeScript)
layout.checks: The hexagonal skeleton is where the fleet standard says it is; loose top-level packages erode the boundary.

domainPurity.name: Domain layer purity
domainPurity.target: 0 files under internal/domain importing an adapter or a framework marker
domainPurity.checks: In hexagonal architecture the domain depends on nothing outward; every framework import in the domain is a dependency-rule violation.

adapters.name: Adapter symmetry
adapters.target: both inbound/ and outbound/ adapters exist under internal/adapters/
adapters.checks: A service that only talks in, or only talks out, has an asymmetric hexagon; the missing side is usually a hidden dependency.

contracts.name: Contract-first APIs
contracts.target: >= 1 OpenAPI and/or AsyncAPI spec under apis/ (or repo root)
contracts.checks: The fleet rule is API-as-product: the spec is the contract, drift-checked in CI. No spec means no checkable contract.

events.name: Event naming discipline
events.target: 100% of distinct event types in the AsyncAPI specs match com.warehouse.<sub>.<ctx>.<entity>.<Event>
events.checks: CloudEvents 1.0 with a mandated type grammar; a type outside the grammar breaks every consumer that pattern-matches it.

fitnessTests.name: In-repo architecture tests
fitnessTests.characteristic: Governance (fitness functions that ship with the code)
fitnessTests.checks: The fleet encodes its own architectural fitness functions as Go tests: catalogue shape, event envelopes, writer topics, MCP authority. Counted, never judged here.

adr.name: Decision records
adr.checks: ADRNNN files under adr/ (docs/adr/ counted too). An architecture that cannot explain its decisions cannot defend them.

mcp.name: MCP server isolation
mcp.target: a separate cmd/mcp binary when the context declares an MCP server
mcp.checks: ADR 0008 fleet-wide: the MCP surface is its own inbound adapter and its own binary, never a route bolted onto the API.

tests.name: Test investment
tests.target: >= 0.8 test lines per code line at HEAD
tests.checks: Same ratio the engineering study scores; repeated here because evolvability is an architectural characteristic, not just hygiene.

ci.name: CI green
ci.target: >= 90% of decided Actions runs green over the last four ISO weeks
ci.checks: The only holistic, dynamic fitness function on the page: it watches the system change over time instead of its shape at HEAD.
